credential_scan.scope: All raw members and copied derived/test artifacts; active OpenRouter key and credential patterns checked without publishing their values.

history_scope_note: Provider histories are library snapshots; mutable message lists can contain later turns. probes.json compares reconstructed initial system/user prefixes, not immutable HTTP request captures.
source_identity_note: Offline analysis can use extracted results anywhere. Live reuse validates original source identities and snapshots; moving data is not a fingerprint-preserving rebind.
